data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Friday, July 24, 2026: Crypto prices retreat on higher U.S. Treasury yields
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC-USD) opened at $65,047.87 on Friday, July 24, 2026, 1.6% lower than Thursday's opening price. Ethereum (ETH-USD) opened at $1,876.92 on Friday, July 24, 2026, down 2.9% from Thursday's opening price.
